_comment: Always-warm content ids. The cron warmer fires HEAD requests for each (id, kind) pair so Cloudflare's edge cache stays populated. Keep this list short — only assets that should NEVER cold-start. Tune from analytics later.
_kinds: kind values: 'video' (the canonical bytes), 'thumbnail' (the card preview), 'captions' (the WebVTT track for films). Match the kind param api/watch.py accepts.

items.note: Ada portrait (kind=video is the canonical key)
